verdicts.reason: Both keep the original's structure: crowd strip on top, black quote below, red attribution. Both carry over a bad hard break that leaves 'INDEED,' alone on its own line, and both use very loose leading that makes the quote look like a stack of separate lines. A is worse because the attribution runs almost to the right canvas edge, past the quote's right margin, and sits jammed under 'EVER HAS.' with too little gap. Its crowd image also starts very close to the top edge. B keeps even ~55px side margins and gives the attribution a proper gap. Its main flaws are the orphaned 'INDEED,' and some empty space at the bottom.
